minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  June 28, 2022

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair
  Robin Carder at 6:37 p.m.

2. Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Robin Carder, Chair – Council Member
  Rick Crosby, Vice Chair – Council Member
  Don Kendrick, Resident
  Denise Fisher, Resident

  Chris Dransfeldt, LVPD
  Mark Rodgers, BUSD
  Joy Lindsay, BUSD
  JR Ranells, City of La Verne
  Erin Beilstein, City of La Verne
  Alfie Sanchez, Majestic Cycling

3. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the April 2022 meeting were approved.

4. School Resource Officer  Administrative Lieutenant Chris Dransfeldt provided
  the SRO Report noting the graduations for the
  schools were well attended and smooth. Chris also
  noted the continuation of tobacco enforcement efforts
  and the progress on identifying youth representatives
  in conjunction with the schools.

5. BUSD Report  Mark Rodgers with the BUSD shared reflections from
  the school year as well as what is expected going into
  the new year. Mark shared specific information about
  the universal transitional kindergarten program.

6. Summer Lunch  JR Ranells with the City of La Verne reported that the
  City had been awarded grant funds from the Tri-City
  Community Wellbeing Grant program to help support
  and enhance the Summer Lunch program. JR shared
  that the program was well underway and that there
  have been an average of 20 participants per day.

7. Executive Board Vacancy  JR provided an update that the unexpired term filled by
  Don Kendrick will be expiring and therefore a new
  process to fill the vacancy will need to take place. The
  vacancy will be posted by the City Clerk’s office and
  any applications will come back to the next YFAC
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes June 28, 2022, page 2

  meeting for consideration and recommendation for
  ultimate appointment by the City Council.

8. Strategic Planning  Erin Beilstein with the City of La Verne introduced the
  strategic planning process and noted several
  programs engaged by other communities that might be
  worthwhile to La Verne. The group entered into
  discussion regarding priorities as well as fundraising
  ideas. The item was tabled for further consideration at
  a future meeting.

9. Public Comment  The group thanked Chair Robin Carder for her many
  years of dedicated service to YFAC and the City of
  La Verne.

10. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for August
  23, 2022.

11. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 8:15 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

JR Ranells
Assistant City Manager
